story.summary: Kim's visit to China is his latest move in an increasingly assertive foreign policy as he seeks to align Pyongyang with Beijing and Moscow in a united front against the United States under what he portrays as a "new Cold War." It's his first visit in a year. North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visits China to inaugurate a new cross-border bridge - AP News.
